theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_pst_level_set_chart_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ), IsOpen W → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → ∃ (D : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)) (Λ : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid (n + 1)) (c : ℕ → Euclid n) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, IsOpen (D k)) ∧ (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (Λ k) (D k)) ∧ (∀ k, InjOn (Λ k) (D k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ z ∈ D k, Λ k z ∈ W ∧ F (Λ k z) = t ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ (Λ k) z) ∧ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (Λ k) z : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1)) = LinearMap.ker (fderiv ℝ F (Λ k z) : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) ∧ (∀ k, closedBall (c k) (ρ k) ⊆ D k) ∧ ∀ y ∈ W, fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0 → F y = t → ∃ k, ∃ z ∈ ball (c k) (ρ k), Λ k z = y
